title: Fix three bugs in a Go concurrent safe map wrapper
description: A SafeMap struct wraps sync.RWMutex around a map but has three bugs: Get uses Lock instead of RLock, Delete forgets to unlock on the early-return path, and Len reads without holding any lock.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in safemap.go:
1. `Get`: change `s.mu.Lock()` to `s.mu.RLock()` and `s.mu.Unlock()` to `s.mu.RUnlock()`
2. `Delete`: add `defer s.mu.Unlock()` at the top (and remove the manual `s.mu.Unlock()` at the bottom) OR add `s.mu.Unlock(); return` on the early-return path
3. `Len`: add `s.mu.RLock()` before and `s.mu.RUnlock()` after (or use defer)
All 4 tests must pass without deadlock or race.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
